rules.statement: Where a claimant fails to appear and adduce evidence on the day fixed for inquiry, an order dismissing the claim is equivalent to an order after investigation under section 245 of the Civil Procedure Code and is conclusive against the claimant unless they bring an action under section 247.
rules.supporting_quote: "In view of the circumstances, in which the order dismissing the plaintiff's vendor Ibrahim Saibo's claim in action D. C. Batticaloa, 4,391, was made, I think the order concluded Ibrahim Saibo and necessarily also the plaintiff. I would dismiss the appeal, with costs."
